decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-886-01, PL-886-02, PL-866-04 Received 21/02/2012 and PL-886-03-A Received 16/04/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for MOT testing purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 08:00-20:00 Monday-Friday, 08:00-16:00 Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for on-site storage of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.  No waste shall be stored on site other than within the designated storage areas.

Condition : 5 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including space for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing PL-886-02 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose (including any additional external storage). No less than four of these spaces, including at least one for use by disabled drivers, shall be made permanently available for customers of the MOT testing service.
Condition : 6 - Car repairs, maintenance or testing shall not be carried out on site other than within the existing building.
Condition : 7 - No sales of cars shall take place on or from the premises.
description: Change of use from B1 and B8 to B1/B2 and B8, retaining first floor offices with general storage
